scope: Nondefault ProjectScene validation only; no renderer adoption, general GS/SH4-paging, ordinary-entry or release claim

quality.maxSh: exact complete source degree, never automatically lower

passes: opaque Mesh/Point into linear target and depth
premultiplied sorted GS into same target, depthTest on, depthWrite off
one IEC conversion to final canvas
colorTarget.capability: test actual float render/blend/depth support; extension name alone insufficient
colorTarget.failure: diagnose GS display only; preserve source and unrelated valid Mesh/Point/Caption/media

precision.runtime: exact pinned GSL native packing: half RGB/logscale/alpha, packed quaternion, shared-exponent SH
precision.sourceAuthority: never packed/LOD/culling data or getBoundingBox; no current draw index in saved anchor
runtimeAdmission: decoded count and degree equal exact source inspection
all decoded/packed mean/scale/quaternion/alpha/SH finite; scales positive
no representable-range saturation; per channel B=0.5+sum(abs(c_lm)*sqrt((2*l+1)/(4*pi))) over all basis indices includingDC; IECDecode(B) <=65504 for the linear half target
valid composed transform/camera projection and declared viewport/target budget
closed goldens/transform rules pass before capability is enabled
precision.errorClaim: fixed golden tolerances only, no general per-pixel or geometric-error promise

picking: explicit selected Asset only; GS uses bound same-Asset Proxy for transient manual proposal; 01a Point requires composed visibility proof or ambiguity
sortGeneration: Discard content-generation-stale results. With unchanged source, the last sort order may remain visible while a new-camera sort is pending, as the fixed WebGL2 backend supports; never roll back source, transforms or camera and never hide the whole Asset just because sorting is pending.

lifetime.coordinator: one per viewport owns GSL renderer and linear target; resident owns SplatMesh
lifetime.decodeConcurrency: one global slot; mark cancelled candidates unadoptable immediately, await the original initialized resolve/reject before disposal and starting the latest queued replacement; do not early-reject that ownership wait
lifetime.loss: dispose adopted GPU/target/sort worker during loss; pending decode stays private until natural settlement then is disposed; discard stale results and rebuild from same live source generation; no immediate vendor-computation abort claim
lifetime.sharedDecoderPool: public GSL API retains idle decoder/WASM pool; exact version schedules retirement after3s..180s depending heap size, not a wall-clock deadline under suspension/throttling; include resources until actual closure in aggregate budgets, never count them as immediately freed
lifetime.gate: repeated cancellation/switch/load/unload must demonstrate bounded workers/heap and retirement before enabling the new connection; failure stops renderer activation without relaxing accepted general resource gates

paging: no automatic SH3 fallback; raw SH4 and paged SH3 are different paths; future SH4 paging requires its own evidence/profile decision
